title: Descriptive Change Is Not A Causal Effect
summary: A map separating eligible panels, claim language, adverse evidence, alternative explanations, attribution, registered counterfactual design, result inspection, and causal publication.
map_question: What evidence and design decisions remain between a reviewed descriptive change and attribution or causal effect?
interpretation_boundary: Claim classification, alternative-explanation assessment, attribution, counterfactual registration, result inspection, and causal publication are separate human decisions. A stronger verb cannot be inferred from the same descriptive evidence.

nodes.label: Eligible longitudinal panel
nodes.note: No Phase 71 panel contains an admitted series.

nodes.label: Proposed claim and class
nodes.note: The exact sentence and evidence ceiling are selected before review.

nodes.label: Complete outcome-evidence packet
nodes.note: Calculation, timing, continuity, adverse evidence, uncertainty, and reproducibility remain inspectable.

nodes.label: Alternative-explanation assessment
nodes.note: Ten categories are assessed without converting silence into none.

nodes.label: Bounded descriptive result
nodes.note: A reviewed level, change, target, or association may be the strongest supportable claim.

nodes.label: Contribution or attribution
nodes.note: Intervention, actor, receiver, comparison basis, alternatives, and spillovers are explicit.

nodes.label: Registered counterfactual design
nodes.note: Question, estimand, controls, assumptions, robustness, and failure rules are frozen before results.

nodes.label: Planned result inspection
nodes.note: Execution, deviations, assumptions, uncertainty, and falsification results are reviewed.

nodes.label: Bounded causal result
nodes.note: A separate human decision may publish only the effect and limits supported by the registered design.

links.note: All thirty-two Phase 72 packets are empty.
No question, class, sentence, or calculation exists.
All eighty alternative-category assessments remain empty.
A descriptive publication still requires dual review and a receipt.
Result inspection is prohibited before registration.
Registration alone does not authorize causal publication.

what_this_map_supports: Seven explicit claim classes with escalating evidence ceilings.
Visible alternative-explanation, attribution, counterfactual, uncertainty, reproducibility, and pre-registration controls.
A fail-closed boundary between design registration, result inspection, and causal publication.
what_this_map_does_not_prove: It does not establish an eligible panel, descriptive result, target attainment, association, attribution, or causal effect.
It does not establish that an alternative explanation is absent or that an identification assumption holds.
It does not create a comparison, composite, score, league table, rank, forecast, or policy-effect claim.
next_records_needed: A real Phase 71 panel with admitted series lineage and a proposed bounded sentence.
A complete twelve-gate evidence packet and ten-category alternative assessment.
If causal language is proposed, a registered twelve-gate design receipt issued before result inspection.
